Music Graph is an ongoing personal project: my Spotify library drawn as a graph. Songs
are nodes, and an edge connects two tracks that share an artist, genre, album, or
playlist. The idea came from a Wikipedia network visualization built with igraph and
Leiden community detection; the pipeline and design here are my own.

### What I did

- Designed the data pipeline in Python. The current library has 7,990 unique tracks.
- Built a three-layer lookup for each artist's genres, to work around Spotify's API
  rate limits: Spotify's top-artist data first, then MusicBrainz ISRC lookups, then a
  rate-limited Spotify fallback. It checks name matches so multi-artist tracks are not
  mis-resolved, and caches results to local JSON so re-runs never hit the API again.

### Where it is going

Next up are Leiden community detection, a Gephi layout, and a web explorer that other
people can point at their own Spotify accounts.
